kept.excerpt: Roath gets our nod as the most viable challenger largely because of his fundraising prowess: he’s raised more than $1.1 million with, he said, a median donation of $25, suggesting a broad base of voter support. Roath also boasts endorsements from Patrick, David Hogg’s group Leaders We Deserve, the Boston Teachers Union, and AFT (American Federation of Teachers) Massachusetts. Lynch is the favorite here, but the prospect of Roath pulling off an upset isn’t far fetched as it initially seemed.
kept.relevance: This local expert preview assesses Lynch as the favorite while documenting the resources and organizational support making Roath a credible challenger.
